static.aboutBody: UyirAngadi is a Tamil Nadu-wide classifieds marketplace for livestock and companion animals. We connect sellers directly with buyers in their own district and language. UyirAngadi is a listing platform only — we never buy, own, store, transport or sell animals, and we do not take part in any transaction between buyers and sellers.
static.termsBody: By using UyirAngadi you agree that all listings are posted by users, that deals are made directly between buyers and sellers, and that UyirAngadi is not a party to any sale. Sellers must post accurate information and have the legal right to sell the animal. Buyers must verify the animal, the seller, ownership documents, health and vaccination records, and any legal requirements before paying. Users who post fraudulent, duplicate or misleading listings may be suspended.
static.privacyBody: We collect only what is needed to run the marketplace: your mobile number (used for OTP login), your name and general location, and the listings you post. Your mobile number is shown to buyers only when you publish a listing so they can contact you. We do not sell your personal data. Exact addresses are never published. You can ask us to delete your account and listings at any time.
static.safetyBody: Always meet the seller in person at a safe, public place and inspect the animal yourself before paying. Check ownership documents, health and vaccination records, and transport rules. Never pay a full advance to someone you have not met. Take a friend or family member with you. Report suspicious listings immediately using the Report button.
